design.purpose: Govern source eligibility, composition, quality, licensing, provenance, contamination prevention, deduplication, partitioning and validation for a future D1 development-scale corpus.

authorityPaths.role: locked acquisition, provenance, licensing, quality and versioning rules
candidate source classes and pre-acquisition approval tiers; not acquisition authority for every document
tokenizer-corpus governance and tokenizer acceptance; not model-pretraining approval
registered raw GovData sources and tranche-1 derived-corpus provenance
tranche-2 German legal-source provenance and reuse finding
tranche-2 construction identity and document boundaries
accepted tokenizer construction authority binding its training corpus to tranche 2

sources.license: Official-provider free-use/reuse finding for offered German-language legal norms; source qualifications retained
work-specific public-domain review plus Project Gutenberg terms

sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.eligibility: preferred when work and jurisdiction status are verified
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.attributionRequirements: preserve source attribution even when not legally required
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.failClosedCondition: unknown work status, jurisdiction conflict or source terms unresolved

sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.eligibility: eligible after exact license and intended-use review
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.modelTrainingPermitted: only after intended-use compatibility is recorded
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.attributionRequirements: fulfill attribution, notice and modification-marking terms
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.failClosedCondition: license ambiguity, incompatible restriction or unmet attribution/share-alike handling

sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.modelTrainingPermitted: only after compatibility and third-party exclusions
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.attributionRequirements: as license requires; provider and resource ID always retained
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.failClosedCondition: catalog-level license assumed for resource, third-party rights unresolved or special conditions incompatible

sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.modelTrainingPermitted: only if exact license and intended use permit
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.failClosedCondition: no exact license, NC/ND incompatibility, private student content or embedded third-party rights unresolved
abstract/index access mistaken for full-text rights, license absent, retracted material unlabelled or sensitive data present

sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.modelTrainingPermitted: only after license compatibility is recorded
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.attributionRequirements: preserve copyright/license notices and repository identity
sourceEligibilityTaxonomy.failClosedCondition: missing or conflicting licenses, secrets, vendored unknown-rights content or unclear generated artifacts

retentionRequirements: candidate metadata only; do not retain payload unless separately authorized
reason-coded rejection record without retaining prohibited payload where unsafe or unlawful
examples: malware payload collections intended for harmful execution
benchmark answers inserted for score inflation

proposedDevelopmentComposition.measurementBasis: accepted unique tokenizer tokens after all exclusions; categories are mutually exclusive primary-domain assignments
proposedDevelopmentComposition.selectionConstraint: Every frozen mixture point must total exactly 100%; the planning point below totals 100% and each value lies within its range.

languagePolicy.measurementBasis: accepted natural-language tokens; code is reported separately and excluded from natural-language share denominator
languagePolicy.permittedAdditionalLanguages: Other valid UTF-8 languages only from eligible, quality-controlled sources and within the additional-language cap.
languagePolicy.unknownLanguageHandling: Quarantine; accept only after deterministic adjudication or label as unknown in measurement. Unknown tokens may not count toward language targets.
languagePolicy.mixedLanguageHandling: Record span-level shares where feasible, primary language, and mixed flag; count tokens proportionally rather than assigning the whole document to one language.
languagePolicy.codeNaturalLanguageDistinction: Detect code blocks/files separately; comments and prose are language-labelled, executable syntax counts toward the code category.

rules.condition: near-empty or low substantive token count
binary contamination or binary masquerading as text
excessive boilerplate, navigation-only page, repeated headers/footers or duplicated paragraphs
rules.action: QUARANTINE; apply only frozen source-specific removal with before/after evidence, otherwise reject

rules.condition: machine-generated spam or templated SEO content
OCR corruption beyond frozen legibility thresholds
extremely long repeated-character runs or excessive symbol density

rules.action: REJECT unless source truth confirms the fragment is a complete intended record
REJECT unless classified as useful structured factual text and diversity caps pass

rules.condition: secret, token, password, private key or credential leakage
source-specific legal restriction or third-party-rights conflict

documentQualityPolicy.thresholdGovernance: Numeric classifier thresholds and source-specific transformations must be frozen and versioned before execution; failures and overrides require reason codes and cannot be silent.

layers.concept: SHA-256 of canonical document bytes; retain one under a frozen provenance/quality precedence rule
SHA-256 after frozen Unicode and whitespace normalization that preserves a reversible link to raw identity
token or character n-gram MinHash/LSH candidate generation followed by exact similarity adjudication under frozen thresholds
normalized paragraph fingerprints and frequency/cross-document coverage analysis; remove boilerplate only under recorded rules
run all fingerprints across the complete composite manifest, retaining every contributing provenance link
group all exact/near-duplicate families before deterministic partition assignment and verify zero family overlap

contaminationPreventionPolicy.protectedSideOperation: An independently authorized evaluator holds protected identities/fingerprints and returns only non-exposing match IDs, aggregate counts and pass/fail outcomes.
controls: hash/identity exclusion where exact protected identities exist
non-reversible fingerprint comparison in protected environment
exclude answer keys and benchmark-specific solution corpora
record adjudication without exposing protected content
contaminationPreventionPolicy.developmentEvaluationIsolation: Development data is selected before training, isolated by document/duplicate family, and never promoted into training after results are observed.
contaminationPreventionPolicy.externalBenchmarkPolicy: Track known benchmark names, source versions and contamination status without acquiring protected examples; execute comparison only under later authority.

trainDevelopmentSplitPolicy.splitUnit: document duplicate-family/group, never token fragments or individual members of a duplicate family
trainDevelopmentSplitPolicy.deterministicAssignment: Hash frozen split-seed identity plus stable group ID, then map to a partition under versioned logic.
trainDevelopmentSplitPolicy.frozenSeedIdentityRequirement: Seed value and hash must be frozen before assignment; this design does not choose the seed.

requiredChecks: no crash on every accepted document
decode round-trip to tokenizer-defined normalized input where applicable
no corpus text interpreted as control tokens

proposedMaximumRules: quarantine any document exceeding 1.0 token per UTF-8 byte
quarantine any document exceeding four times its language/domain median on both tokens-per-byte and tokens-per-character

tokenizerCompatibilityPolicy.roundTripExceptionPolicy: Any expected non-identity must be explained by the accepted tokenizer's immutable behavior and versioned; silent lossy normalization is prohibited.

malformedEmptyValidationPolicy.scope: every file and every candidate document before acceptance, then reconcile after all filters
reconciliationRules: accepted plus rejected plus quarantined equals total candidate documents
accepted and rejected byte totals reconcile to decoded candidate bytes with documented container overhead
each rejected document has one primary and optional secondary reason codes
no decode, empty, malformed or zero-token failure is silently dropped

domainMeasurementPolicy.method: Frozen document-level primary domain and optional secondary labels, token-weighted aggregate reporting, unknown/ambiguous categories retained.
